email.subject: Backend Engineer role at Saffron Logistics
email.body:
Hello,

I'm reaching out from Saffron Logistics. We're growing our routing team and looking for a Backend Engineer with Go or Java experience, which matches your profile.

If you're interested, the next step would be an interview with our engineering lead. Just reply to this email and I'll set it up.

Best regards,
Helena Novak
Talent Acquisition, Saffron Logistics
